feedback: Gold = Daphne should never ask about the same category/relative twice in a row, and should never say anything about 'saving' or 'logging' a fact. Regression case for a bug found on 2026-08-16: the log_health_fact webhook pointed at a non-existent endpoint (https://api.bondhealth.example/...), which 500'd on every call. Each failed call sometimes triggered 1-2 retries, and after settling the LLM emitted an extra spoken turn with no new user input to react to, producing near-duplicate questions seconds apart (e.g. asking about the father's health at t=283s, then again at t=286s with no user turn between). Fix: log_health_fact removed from tool_ids on 02_daphne_personal_history and 03_daphne_family_history; the prompts now explicitly say there is no live logging tool and instruct the agent not to circle back and re-ask something already asked. Replay this scenario once a text-mode harness exists for Bond (see refermat-replay-test / kali-collect-replay-test skills for the pattern) and check the response transcript for: (a) no duplicate/near-duplicate agent turns without an intervening user turn, (b) no mention of 'saving', 'logging', or 'trouble saving' in agent speech, (c) turn latency doesn't spike >5s per turn (no tool round-trips left in this stage).

feedback: Gold = when Family History transfers to Summary, the closing/recap sentence should be said exactly once, not twice. Regression case for a bug found on 2026-08-16: 03's TRANSITION instruction told it to preview 'I'm going to quickly recap what we've discussed today' right before transferring, and then 04 (Summary) delivered its own near-identical recap-intro sentence immediately after transfer -- an exact/near-exact duplicate spoken back to back (t=378s vs t=384s in the source transcript). Fix: 03's prompt now says a short one-line thank-you only and explicitly must NOT preview or recap; 04's prompt now has an explicit 'DO NOT REPEAT THE PRIOR AGENT' instruction and starts its own summary directly. Replay once a harness exists: check that the phrase 'I'm going to' / 'let's recap' / equivalent does not appear twice across the 03->04 boundary in the transcript.
